  │  /tools                                     │
  │  Available Tools                            │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    List all available tools the agent can use.

  Usage:
    /tools

  Details:
    Displays the full list of tools available to RadSim, including
    file operations, git, shell, search, testing, and more.

  Examples:
    $ /tools

  Related: /help
